concerns.text: T017 implements McNemar's test (FR-005, SC-003) but is marked as incomplete/unchecked. The spec mandates this test for statistical significance; leaving it unimplemented in the task list violates the requirement to measure SC-003.

T019b generates `benchmark_results.csv` (SC-001, SC-002) but is marked incomplete. This artifact is the 'Single Source of Truth' (Constitution IV) for all downstream metrics. Its absence in the task list prevents verification of FR-003 and SC-005.

T021 implements failure classification (FR-006, SC-004) but is marked incomplete. The spec requires distinguishing 'Geometric Ambiguity' from 'Semantic Gap'. Without this task, the research question regarding the necessity of neural understanding cannot be answered.

T030a implements sensitivity analysis for the 85% threshold (SC-005). It is marked incomplete. The spec explicitly requires this analysis to justify the threshold assumption; omitting it weakens the validity of the success/failure verdict.

T031 generates the final research report (Constitution IV). It is marked incomplete. The project cannot claim a 'Single Source of Truth' deliverable without this aggregation step, violating the constitution's core principle.

T032 creates the root README for accessibility. It is marked incomplete. While less critical than data artifacts, the spec implies a complete, runnable project structure; a missing entry point violates the 'Reproducibility' principle (Constitution I) for new researchers.

T005d defines `benchmark_result.schema.yaml` but is marked incomplete. T019b depends on this schema for validation. Without the schema definition task being marked complete, the downstream benchmark generation lacks its required interface contract.
